testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel adding a property to the model-state table: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:827:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel adding a property to the model-state table ✔ Given an empty part with Primary and two named model states is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Model State branch is expanded ✔ When the user chooses Edit Table from the Model State branch context menu ✔ Then the model-state table dialog opens ✔ And its member table lists Primary and both named states ✔ And the member table has a Member column ✔ When the user selects the Properties category ✔ And the user selects Category under the Summary group ✔ And the user adds the selected property to the table ✔ Then Category appears in the chosen-property list ✔ And a Category column appears in the member table ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user cancels the dialog and reopens Edit Table ✔ Then the member table has a Member column ✔ And it does not have a Category column ✔ When the user cancels the dialog ✔ Then the same part remains active
